policy: Maintained application TypeScript stays under the original ESLint rules; maintained .mjs tooling also receives syntax checks. Only this byte-verified generated integration is reported separately. Original repository-wide lint remains available and failing until upstream resolves its diagnostics.

files.provenance: Identical output reproduced in an isolated temporary repository with initial commits and session pushes disabled; application repository plugin not modified.
files.remediation: Use an upstream-supported generator fix, then explicitly review the generated diff and update this registry. A changed or authored replacement fails the application boundary check. Do not hand-patch or broadly ignore .opencode.
